items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And there was Arthur Arthadeaux. We used to call him Artur; Artur(?) in patois. A really fine looking man.

ctx.x: No, there are no more Arthadeaux. Louis was the youngest brother. And there was Arthur Arthadeaux. We used to call him Artur; Artur(?) in patois. A really fine looking man. They had sisters, and they've got some of them out in the country.
You have Manuel Perez. He was a great name. This is a great name trumpet player.
